name: Image-Based Rendering for Volume Surfaces
aliases: Image-based volume rendering with keyview caching
definition: An acceleration technique that caches a fully volume-rendered image (keyview) and reuses it for novel views by texture-mapping it to a surface model, only ray-casting newly visible regions.
summary: Image-Based Rendering for Volume Surfaces accelerates rendering by caching a keyview and using explicit geometric surface models with projective texture mapping to generate novel views, distinguishing itself from sibling methods through higher fidelity in regions with significant occlusion changes.
